# Hyperise

Hyperise is a personalization toolkit that enables sales and marketing teams to add dynamic, personalized elements to images, videos, and websites, enhancing engagement across various channels.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hyperise/.

## Actions

- **Create Client Account**: Create a new Hyperise client account.
- **Generate Personalized Short Link**: Generate a personalized short link.
- **Hyperise Prospect Business Data (CRUD)**: Perform CRUD operations on Hyperise business prospect records.
- **List Image Templates** (read-only): List active image templates.
- **User Authentication** (read-only): Authenticate an API token and retrieve user details.
